Minister of Roads and Buildings B.C. Janardhan Reddy on Monday (September 21, 2026) asked the party leaders and activists to work in coordination to strengthen the party at the grassroot level.

The Minister held a meeting with party leaders, activists, and ward/cluster in-charges at the party office in Koilkuntla. During the meeting, he discussed about strengthening the party, coordinating with the public at the grassroots level, and effectively disseminating information about government welfare and development programmes to the people.

Mr. Janardhan Reddy advised the cadre to work in coordination, identify public issues, and strive for their resolution. He instructed the leaders and activists to remain accessible to the public and create awareness about government welfare and development initiatives.

Meanwhile, a section of workers met the Minister and explained their grievances. They submitted a representation requesting the allocation of land to establish a dedicated Auto Nagar for workers. They explained that the establishment of an Auto Nagar would provide necessary facilities and enable them to carry out their trade effectively.

Mr. Janardhan Reddy listened attentively to the issues faced by the workers and stated that the matter of land allocation for the Auto Nagar would be examined. He assured them that he would consult with the officials concerned and take necessary steps.
